items.title: 4.4 Gases ka molar mass aur kasafat (density) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 4.4, printed page 80, with Sample Problem 4.9 worked and Quick Check 4.3 answered.

blocks.title: Density (kasafat)
blocks.text: Density kisi substance ka fi unit volume mass hai, yani 1 unit volume mein kitna mass hai.

STP par har gas ka ek mole (yani us ka molar mass) ek hi volume, 22.4 dm³, leta hai. Is liye gas ki density us ke molar mass par depend karti hai: jis gas ka molar mass zyada ho, us ki density bhi zyada hogi, aur kam ho to kam. Agar STP par gas ki density maloom ho to us ka molar mass nikal sakte hain.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: STP par molar mass = density x 22.4. Density g/dm³ mein ho to jawab g/mol mein aata hai.

blocks.title: Sample Problem 4.9
blocks.problem: Us gas ka molar mass nikalein jis ki STP par density 1.97 g/dm³ hai.
steps: m = d x V, aur 1 mole ka V = 22.4 dm³

blocks.prompt: Us gas ka molar mass nikalein jis ki STP par density 1.34 g/dm³ hai. (Mazeed: 1.43 g/dm³ wali gas ka bhi nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: 1.34 x 22.4 = 30.0 g/mol (yeh ethane C₂H₆ ya NO ho sakti hai). 1.43 x 22.4 = 32.0 g/mol, jo oxygen O₂ se milta hai.

items: STP par molar mass = density x 22.4 (1.97 g/dm³ se 44.1 g/mol).
